name: Toronto Waldorf School

description: One of Canada's few complete Waldorf schools, from infant care through Grade 12, on a wooded campus north of Toronto. Inspected by the Ontario ministry to grant OSSD credits; offers a high-school boarder (homestay-type) programme and exchanges.

attributes.philosophy: Waldorf developmental curriculum; arts, movement and environmental education woven through all grades; nature-connected campus.

legal_status.label: Private school operating under a Notice of Intention to Operate (Education Act s.16, Ontario)

attributes.curriculum: Waldorf curriculum; secondary courses for OSSD credit.
attributes.qualifications_offered: Ontario Secondary School Diploma (OSSD) credits — school listed as 'Offers credits toward the OSSD'.
accreditation: Ontario Ministry of Education inspection for OSSD credit-granting

tuition.notes: Grades 1–8 $23,880 + activity fee $220–$1,655; Grades 9–12 $26,470 + $2,420; high-school boarders full year $31,660 + $2,420. One-time enrolment fee $2,000 (K–12).

attributes.additional_fees: Enrolment fee $2,000 (one-time); activity fees by grade.
